gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the charger's amps decide how long the battery takes to refill: Minn Kota's own onboard-charger example gives 10 A per bank, which puts a 12 V 100 Ah lithium battery at about 100 Ah ÷ 10 A ≈ 10 h from empty, while Redodo says its matching 14.6 V 20 A charger refills it in about 5 h. That battery's 100 A BMS also carries the 50 A peak draw of a 50–55 lb 12 V Minn Kota with twice the margin, where Redodo's plain 12 V 50 Ah (50 A BMS) has none.
standout_why: Compared against the pages ChatGPT cited: Minn Kota Trolling Motor Power Considerations (110 Ah per battery for 6–8 h, 5% voltage-drop limit, no amp figures in its text), Minn Kota Deep Cycle Battery Selection (at least 110 Ah, Group 27, 60 A MKR-27 breaker, recharge lead-acid within 12–24 h, no charger amps), and the Minn Kota Wiring & Battery Guide (the page came back empty). Among the top results, sonar-wise lists max amp draw by thrust and Garmin's 60 A continuous minimum but gives no charger amps or refill time. Minn Kota's lithium page (uncited) gives a 10 A-per-bank charger example and a 14.5 V max but no refill arithmetic. ChatGPT's own answer only says 'confirm the BMS supports max current' and never sizes a charger. So no rival works out refill time from charger amps or checks a named battery's BMS rating against the motor's draw. Half of it is in the rivals (the amp-draw table and the advice to check the BMS), so this is not a 3.
kit_items: Battery (12 V, 50–55 lb motor): Redodo 12V 100Ah Lithium Trolling Motor Battery with Low-Temp Protection. 12.8 V × 100 Ah = 1,280 Wh. Redodo lists usable capacity at 101–105 Ah and a 100 A BMS across its 12 V 100 Ah series. Minn Kota's 50–55 lb 12 V peak is 50 A on a 60 A breaker, so the BMS covers it twice over. At a sustained 50 A peak, runtime is 100 Ah ÷ 50 A ≈ 2 h as a worst case.
Charger: Redodo 14.6V 20A LiFePO4 Charger. 100 Ah ÷ 20 A ≈ 5 h to refill, which matches Redodo's own '5 hours' claim. A Minn Kota onboard bank at 10 A takes about 10 h.

Avoid for a 50–55 lb motor: Redodo's plain 12V 50Ah (non-Bluetooth). Its 50 A BMS equals the motor's 50 A peak, which leaves zero margin under a 60 A breaker. The 12V 50Ah Bluetooth version is rated 60 A continuous.

24 V option (70–80 lb motor): Redodo 24V 100Ah Group 31 Bluetooth plus Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI charger. Minn Kota's 80 lb peak is 56 A on a 60 A breaker, under the battery's 100 A BMS. Capacity is 2,560 Wh, and Redodo says the 29.2 V 20 A charger refills it in about 5 h. A 12 V-per-bank onboard charger cannot charge a single 24 V battery, so a 29.2 V charger is required.
